description: axnic Renovate preset for Pulumi providers. Consume it with { "extends": ["local>axnic/.github:pulumi"] }.
Extends the default preset. The generated SDKs (sdk/) are rebuilt by codegen and never updated by hand.

customManagers.description: Pulumi CLI version pinned in .pulumi.version (read by the vfox-pulumi mise plugin).

packageRules.description: The provider's own generated Go SDK, required by examples/go through a local replace directive: never a registry update.
The Pulumi engine and SDKs move together: Go sdk/pkg, the npm SDK and the CLI pinned in .pulumi.version.
Provider framework and test helpers (pulumi-go-provider, providertest, schema tooling).
